title: Store Operations Charge Table: Packing Charge on a Delivery & Pickup Services Order Cancelled Before Dispatch
content:
The packing charge retained on the cancellation of a Delivery & Pickup Services order before dispatch depends on who cancelled and when, as the order's placing record and its cancellation record show them. The packing charge retained is kept back from the refund of the cancelled order's speed fee.

## Charge table

| Cancellation reason | Cancelled on | Packing charge retained |
|---|---|---|
| at the patient's request | a later day than the day the order was placed | $2.00 |
| at the patient's request | the day the order was placed | $1.00 |
| item unavailable | any day | none |
| address outside the delivery area | any day | none |

The days compared are the date the order was placed and the date it was cancelled; the time of day does not enter.

## Hypothetical cases

- Placed on 9 July at 08:15, cancelled at the patient's request on 9 July at 21:40: same day, $1.00.
- Placed on 9 July at 23:50, cancelled at the patient's request on 10 July at 00:05: a later day, $2.00.
- Placed on 9 July, cancelled on 12 July because an item was unavailable: none.
